title: Inventory Value before the release counts every part as tracked
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use an active tracked part, part A, that was at the test location before this release was installed and that no other test needs.
  • Use a date before the release, date A, on which the Inventory Value report lists part A.
  • Write down part A's Qty and Total Cost on the Inventory Value report for date A.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click Reports in the top bar.
  5. Click Inventory Value.
  6. Pick the test location only in the Location filter.
  7. Set the as-of date to date A.
  8. Type part A's part number in the report's Search box.
  9. Set the as-of date to today.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch on.

Step 2:

  • The switch turns off.

Step 3:

  • Part A reads "Not Tracked".

Step 4:

  • The Reports page opens.

Step 5:

  • The Inventory Value report opens.

Step 6:

  • The report shows the test location only.

Step 7:

  • The report shows date A.

Step 8:

  • Part A is listed for date A with the same Qty and Total Cost you wrote down: a date before the release counts it as tracked.

Step 9:

  • For today part A is not listed, because it is untracked today.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part), story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part)

  • Feature Overview, Accounting: “Inventory Value figures already saved for past dates keep their saved values. The count of bins below zero, which ships with this release, applies from release on and does not rework earlier dates.”
  • S4-R9: “The Inventory Value report does not include untracked parts.”
